newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via five-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via five-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system via five-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The add move was in line with the market's expectations.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, federal funds changed hands at 5-3/8 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
The Fed was said to have entered the market before its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT time due to the money market's abbreviated session ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday.
